title: RecurrencePattern
description: Describes the frequency by which a recurring event repeats.

interval.description: The number of units between occurrences, where units can be in days, weeks, months, or years.

daysOfWeek.description: A collection of the days of the week on which the event occurs.

dayOfMonth.description: The day of the month on which the event occurs.

month.description: The month in which the event occurs (1-12).

firstDayOfWeek.description: The first day of the week.

index.description: The week index for relative monthly and yearly patterns.
